lastTask: Implement Byte 11b bounded melody rest/thin compiler

projectState.summary: Byte 11b is implemented on `codex/byte-11b` and ready for Claude review. The slow-thinking lifecycle moved into `src/slow-thinking.ts`, accepted valid thoughts now produce an explicit handoff, and the automatic melody request is narrowed to `rest`, `simplify`, and `change_density`. Accepted intents compile into one bounded future playback window, exposed as `window.thinking.getSlowPlayback()`, and only affect melody through the existing note-decision path as a rest or thinning decision. The compiler retargets to a future bar boundary, does not overwrite an active window, and clears on stop, song/timing changes, or leaving rehearsal. Validation so far: `npm run build`, `npm run smoke` (14/14), `npm audit`, and a live in-app browser DOM sanity check.
